mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction, reducing consumer spending and business investment, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average during early recession phases signals manufacturing slowdowns, reducing corporate revenue growth and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below 6-month moving average during early recession, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% per annum signals sustained inflationary pressures, prompting monetary tightening and reducing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 jobs signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS < -100000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rising CPIAUCSL above 3.0% indicate stagflationary supply shocks, increasing inflation and reducing real corporate profits, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC for joint signal < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% per annum signals active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
